learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to determine impeller dimensions, especially impeller diameter, widths, angles, blade shapes, and the number of blades. In addition to theoretical formulas, students master the application of empirical methods that take into account real effects such as friction influences.

Students learn calculations based on realistic, practical values. Calculation methods for the fluid dynamic design of impellers are taught. Impellers of centrifugal pumps are presented in particular detail, so that students learn the correct dimensioning of flow elements, such as guide vanes or volute casings.

syllabus_topics: Determination of the main dimensions of centrifugal pump impellers
Components of turbomachinery: nozzles, diffusers, volute casings, inlet and outlet casings
Forces and compensation: axial and radial forces
assessment_rules: The form of examination (written or oral) will be announced at the beginning of the course. The module examination must be passed to earn credit points. The grading is weighted by ECTS credit points.
